Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units. Source assays filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1267250'. Join activities on assay_id. Join molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno. Filter rows where standard_relation = '=' and standard_value IS NOT NULL and standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
